Here's a description of the provided scientific line plots, following the specified guidelines:

The plots illustrate training rewards over a sequence of steps for different models. Both plots share the same axes: the x-axis is labeled "Steps" and spans from 0 to 500, with tick labels at intervals of 100. The x-axis scale is linear. The y-axis is labeled "Training Rewards" and ranges from 0.0 to 0.4, with tick labels appearing as 0.0, 0.2, and 0.4. The y-axis scale is linear.

The upper plot showcases training rewards for the "Easy" training set. A blue line, represented by circular markers, depicts the "Llama-On-Policy-Easy" model, starting at approximately 0.20 and reaching roughly 0.35 by the end of the 500 steps. A red line, solid in style, represents “Llama-LUFFY-Easy”, beginning at a value of approximately 0.21 and increasing to a value close to 0.36 at the endpoint. Both lines exhibit fluctuating behavior throughout the plotted steps.

The lower plot, representing the "Hard" training set, features a blue, dotted line with circular markers depicting the "Llama-On-Policy-Hard" model; it commences at approximately 0.08 and fluctuates around this initial value, reaching roughly 0.15 at 500 steps. A red, solid line illustrates “Llama-LUFFY-Hard”, starting at approximately 0.07 and oscillating to around 0.14 by the end of the 500 steps.
